ai.title: Project understanding agent replaces workspace profiler on GPT-6 Luna
ai.summary: The workspace profiler subsystem is renamed to project understanding, with the agent ID changed from `freebuff-workspace-profiler` to `freebuff-project-understanding` and its model switched from DeepSeek V4 Flash to GPT-6 Luna to prevent project files from reaching DeepSeek's API. The agent is built at runtime from a backend-served template, runs four reading rounds before forcing a `set_output` call, and offers only `list_directory`, `glob`, `read_files`, and `set_output` tools. The SDK gains two new `RunOptions` flags: `confineFileToolsToProject` (backs a new `ProjectFence` that refuses paths outside `cwd` via symlink-resolved containment) and `refuseNonTextFileReads` (refuses non-text extensions and NUL-siffed binaries via a shared `non-text-files` module). This is one of five distinct changes; others include a new `DESKTOP_PROJECT_UNDERSTANDING` analytics event, a `broad-roots` guard that blocks home/Desktop/Documents/system paths, and a cost-estimation helper pinned to GPT-6 Luna's OpenRouter standard-tier list prices.
ai.evidence: New files `common/src/project-understanding/agent.ts` and `sdk/src/project-understanding.ts` introduce the `freebuff-project-understanding` agent; `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` renames `FREEBUFF_WORKSPACE_PROFILER_AGENT_ID` to `FREEBUFF_PROJECT_UNDERSTANDING_AGENT_ID` and switches its model from `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` to `FREEBUFF_GPT_6_LUNA_MODEL_ID`.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show which Desktop or Cloud service invokes `understandProject` or what triggers the due-check, so the user-visible timing of project profiles is not fully traceable.

changes.what: Renamed the workspace-profile module to project-understanding, switched the agent model to GPT-6 Luna, and tightened its tool set to four read-only tools.
Renamed workspace-profile template and stats exports to project-understanding, added a non-text file guard to the line-counting predicate, and introduced a shared binary-sniff and extension list.
Added the SDK-side project-understanding client, a due-check/report API against `/api/v1/project-understanding`, and a `countProjectFiles` helper that respects read limits and the non-text guard.

Added `confineFileToolsToProject` and `refuseNonTextFileReads` to `RunOptions`, a new `ProjectFence` that rejects paths outside `cwd` as written or through symlinks, and per-tool enforcement in `handleToolCall` for `code_search`, `list_directory`, `glob`, and `read_files`.
Added the `DESKTOP_PROJECT_UNDERSTANDING` analytics event, emitted once per project-understanding attempt on the Desktop surface with its outcome.
